name: Multitask Lair (Minds In The Pizza Oven) Demo
author: screenburn99
description: Don't multitask, kids! These days it seems time is always going by too fast, and it can be temping to try to do that assignment due tomorrow while watching a movie or playing video games; but this only leads to disaster. In this multitasking experience, you must play various classic games, but the longer you play, the more games appear for you to play at the same time! Can you play Flappy Bird, Tetris, Pong, and more all at the same time? Can you reach the Good Ending and beat the game? I don't know, CAN YOU??
